title: The affine polynomial quotient chart of universal incidence
statement: Let k be a field, A a commutative k-algebra, L an invertible module on Spec A, e a free global generator and s_i finitely many global sections. The universal incidence scheme of [def-zl-bertini-universal-family] is isomorphic to Spec(A[x_i]/(sum coeff_e(s_i) x_i)). Under the inverse of this isomorphism, the universal projection is Spec of the composite k[x_i] -> A[x_i] -> A[x_i]/(sum coeff_e(s_i) x_i). Global section coefficients are transported by the canonical Gamma(Spec A) -> A isomorphism. No domain, reducedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed. Conventions: multivariate polynomial rings [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], scheme base change [def-pc-base-change], invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], section zero schemes [def-pc-zero-scheme].

proof.text: Use the polynomial ambient pullback square to identify the ambient scheme with Spec A[x_i]. Pull back the universal zero ideal by this isomorphism. The arbitrary-scheme zero-ideal formula and free-generator coefficient formula identify its global affine ideal with the principal incidence equation via GammaSpecIso. An affine closed subscheme is the spectrum of this quotient: its top affine cover map is an open immersion with full range and is therefore an isomorphism. Transport the quotient through GammaSpecIso, and use the comap pullback isomorphism to recover the original incidence scheme. Compatibility of the cover inclusion, quotient equivalence and ambient first projection proves the asserted formula for the parameter map.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_bertiniAffineIncidenceChart
    (k A : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (L : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    {e : Γ(L, ⊤)} (he : IsFreeGenerator e)
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(L, ⊤)) :
    ∃ e : (bertiniUniversalIdeal
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) L s).subscheme ≅
        Spec (.of (MvPolynomial I A ⧸ Ideal.span
          {∑ i, MvPolynomial.C ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom (he.coeff (s i))) *
            MvPolynomial.X i})),
      e.inv ≫ bertiniUniversalProjection
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) L s =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k A))))
